description: Show the commits and the diff between two commits of the git repository in this session's folder, for a review. It runs git with no configured programs (hooks, filters, diff helpers, signature checks) and sends nothing. Use it instead of git log, diff or show in a shell.

base.description: The commit the change starts from: a commit id or a branch or tag name, such as main, 1a2b3c4 or HEAD~1

head.description: The last commit of the change, in the same form

stat.description: Only the changed files and line counts, not the full diff

name: read_diff
